mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (below 0.5%) compress equity discount rates and boost valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates (above 6.5%) signal weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 6.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: In periods where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, the S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation environment (CPIAUCSL < 220), a rising CPIAUCSL (indicating accelerating inflation) signals improving economic conditions and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve delays tightening.
failure_condition: In low-inflation periods (CPIAUCSL < 220), the 20-day SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of cases when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 105) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 105, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST above its 3-month average) reflects strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the housing sector drives economic growth.
failure_condition: HOUST shows a positive 3-month average trend but 60-day SPX returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), the Federal Reserve's policy shift increases discount rates for equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising by at least 0.25% in 3 months), the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth (PAYEMS rising above 0.5% in 3 months) indicates a robust labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% in 3 months, the S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
